change_summary: Sweep the SPY T+1 return floor for a fixed 1.5x extra paper-notional scalar on accepted neutral-underreaction SEC financial-report rows.

gate.rule: Pass if aggregate EV/PnL improve versus accepted exp-20260518-009, EV and PnL improve in all three fixed windows, no window regresses, max drawdown worsens by <=0.5pp, adjusted trades >= 6, and adjusted trades are present in all 3 windows.

hypothesis: Inside the accepted SEC financial-report neutral-underreaction paper cohort, T+1 relative strength should be trusted more when SPY did not sell off hard on the same T+1 session. A bounded extra paper-notional scalar should improve replacement value without changing queue eligibility, capacity, or live orders.
interpretation: Neutral-underreaction SEC financial-report paper rows improved when the T+1 broad market backdrop was not deeply adverse. The best passing profile keeps live/default orders disabled and only changes default-off paper notional.

next_evidence_needed: Move the accepted paper-only rule into shared SEC financial-report sleeve code with parity coverage; keep live/default orders disabled until closed forward replacement-value evidence matures.
